integrity: A self-contained argument and standalone finite checker support the stated theorem. The finite tests are not universal proof. Originality is assessed against the inspected literature, with residual risk of unindexed equivalent coverage; no independent mathematical audit has occurred.
limitations: Finite connected simple graphs with unit edge lengths for the Lipschitz measurement and positive conductances and vertex masses; nonlinear \(1<p<\infty\), \(p\ne2\). No result claimed about fixed-time unbounded amplification, arbitrary metric lengths, or the linear classification on noncomplete graphs.
title: Complete-graph rigidity of two-input Lipschitz contraction for nonlinear discrete \(p\)-heat
